**What's your idea?**
Enter the idea here
**Does it solve a problem?**
If yes, enter the problem. If no, type "No."
**Is another issue created with this already?**
This will help us determine if the ideas should merge!
**Is there a PR (Pull Request) that already has this feature? If so, please mention it.**
Look in the Pull Requests tab. If there is one, type "Yes." then tag the PR using "#" then the number ID. If no, then type no.
